# Pablo Bonucci — pablobbb.github.io

## Who I am

Pablo Bonucci is a Principal Frontend Engineer with 15+ years of experience building frontend systems and the teams that build them well. He specialises in design systems and frontend architecture.

## Current role

Principal Frontend Engineer at iubenda, a legal tech product used by 1M+ businesses worldwide. Setting the technical vision for frontend across B2B and B2C surfaces.

## Background

- Built a 30+ component design system from scratch at QubicaAMF
- Migrated 3+ legacy products to Vue 3 + TypeScript, reducing bundle size by ~25%
- Mentored engineers across all seniority levels
- Co-founded Z-INDEX99, a web agency that delivered 20+ projects
- Deep expertise in Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, design systems, and frontend architecture

## What I write about

Technical articles on design systems, Vue.js, frontend architecture, and engineering leadership. Published on this site and on Medium (@pablobbb).
